content.short: Livepeer Subgraph offers a GraphQL API to access Livepeer on-chain protocol data.
content.description: Since 2019, Livepeer Subgraph has been among Graph Protocol's first ten mainnet migration partners. It enables indexing and querying of Livepeer on-chain data through a GraphQL API endpoint, making Livepeer data accessible for developers. It also provides real-time pricing information and performance metrics that node operators rely on to monitor activity and optimize operations. Together, these insights help developers build custom dashboards and analytics tools tailored to the Livepeer ecosystem.
